claim: Select a DMA path only where capability and hardware-IM2 gates allow it, and make the CPU-only and unknown-core fallbacks pass the same ABI and negative controls.

evidence.text: The shared capability and hardware-IM2 gate selects ordinary DMA only where supported; CPU-only and older/unknown-core paths pass the same ABI and negative controls (1,728 DMA gate/fallback cases).
evidence.quote: The shared capability and hardware-IM2 gate selects ordinary DMA only where supported; CPU-only and older/unknown-core paths pass the same ABI and negative controls.
